jobs.description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is versatile and passionate about its craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Manager, Anti-Cheat Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s Windows client services. You’ll set technical direction, shape priorities, and ensure the team delivers secure, reliable capabilities across Vanguard’s Anti-Cheat suite in a timely manner. While your primary focus will be enabling the team and driving outcomes, your strong fluency in cheat communities and techniques will allow you to guide architecture, challenge technical decisions, and step directly into complex debugging or investigations when needed. You’ll help the team anticipate and analyze emerging cheat techniques, then translate those findings into effective detections, mitigations, and preventative controls.

Responsibilities:

• Manage, identify, recruit, interview, and hire engineers to help the team scale effectively
• Set direction and drive high-impact anti-cheat capabilities from ambiguity through production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
• Lead the team in rapidly translating emerging threats into resilient detections and preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed at scale
• Balance immediate threat response with proactive technical investments that anticipate adversaries’ next moves or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
• Guide and participate in complex investigations involving highly evasive cheats and operating-system manipulation techniques
• Ensure the team can diagnose and resolve complex compatibility, reliability, and security issues in highly opaque environments, stepping into the details when needed
• Build trusted relationships with game teams as internal customers, helping them understand their cheating ecosystems, integrate Anti-Cheat effectively, and make informed tradeoffs across security, player experience, scope, and delivery
• Establish clear priorities and technical expectations, helping engineers navigate uncertainty and make sound decisions across security, compatibility, performance, and operational risk
• Partner across engineering, product, operations, and game teams to align dependencies, communicate risk, and deliver anti-cheat capabilities successfully across Riot’s portfolio

Required Qualifications:

• 2+ years of experience leading product or developing engineers, either as an Engineering Manager or as a Technical Product Lead
• Familiarity with cheat-development or game-security research communities and a practical understanding of modern cheat techniques and anti-cheat evasions
• Strong understanding of Anti-Cheat architectures, with the ability to evaluate designs, guide technical discussions, and engage directly when complex problems require it
• Experience leading work on low-level, security-sensitive systems and helping teams navigate tradeoffs across security, reliability, compatibility, performance, and delivery
• Working knowledge of Windows security model and security feature suite such as Secure Boot, HVCI, and measured boot attestation

Desired Qualifications:

• Familiarity with reverse-engineering techniques and workflows, including the analysis of packed, protected, or obfuscated binaries, with the judgment to translate technical findings into priorities, investments, and defensive strategy
• Working knowledge of the Windows kernel and driver model, sufficient enough to guide architecture, assess technical risk, and oversee the development and operation of production-grade kernel-mode drivers
• Working knowledge of advanced evasion techniques involving hypervisors, DKOM, EPT manipulation, vulnerable drivers, or hardware-assisted cheats, with the ability to reason about their implications for product and technical strategy
• Basic understanding of runtime integrity verification, behavioral detection, client attestation, and other signature-less anti-cheat techniques, including how to prioritize investments across these defensive approaches
• Experience balancing near-term responses to emerging threats with longer-term, proactive investments intended to anticipate how adversaries and the broader security landscape will evolve
• Experience partnering with internal customers, building trusted relationships, translating their needs into technical priorities, and leading productive conversations around scope, risk, sequencing, and delivery tradeoffs

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks:

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds and runs anthropic.com and claude.com, brand web surfaces where most of the world meets Claude and Anthropic for the first time. They carry our research, product launches, policy work, and brand, and they ship at the pace of a fast-moving company.

You'll manage a small, senior team of web engineers, owning the full stack behind our marketing web: CMS architecture, the publishing pipeline, the design system in code, and the campaign and launch experiences tied to model and product releases. This role sits inside Brand Creative and partners closely with design, editorial, marketing, and product growth engineering. We want a player-coach: comfortable setting technical direction without an existing playbook, staying close to the code and the launches, and building the tooling that lets designers and editors publish without an engineer in the loop.

Responsibilities

• Manage and grow the team: coach, hire, and set the bar for craft and reliability
• Own the technical roadmap for anthropic.com and claude.com: CMS architecture, publishing workflow, performance, SEO health, localization, the production design system, deploy pipeline, on-call, and incident response
• Run launch engineering for model, product, and campaign moments, shipping high-quality pages on tight, shifting timelines without heroics
• Build the brand tooling layer: internal tools, integrations, and Claude-in-the-loop workflows that let designers, writers, and marketers publish safely without engineering as a bottleneck
• Partner with design and editorial on creative technology, data visualizations, interactive explainers, campaign experiences, that need real engineering, not a template
• Align web engineering work with Marketing, Product, Comms, and core Engineering, and say no to what doesn't move brand and business goals

You may be a good fit if you have

• 10+ years in software engineering, 5+ managing engineers, with that time spent as an engineering manager inside a marketing, brand, or design engineering organization specifically, not just a product engineering one
• Owned a high-traffic marketing or brand web surface end to end: CMS, frontend, infrastructure, and the publishing workflow around it
• Strong frontend depth yourself, TypeScript, React, modern CSS, a modern headless CMS, and a real preference for staying close to the code
• Built tooling that made non-engineers faster and safer, with a concrete story of what changed
• Shipped under real launch pressure with cross-functional partners, without dropping the quality bar
• Comfortable operating at the seam between Design, Marketing, and Engineering
• Deep interest in AI and excitement about putting Claude into the build and publish loop itself, not just on the page

Strong candidates may also have

• Held a Head of Web Engineering or equivalent platform lead title at a product company
• Built localization and multi region web infrastructure
• Come from a company where brand and product web sat close together: design tools, productivity, or developer tools
• Led design systems or component library work that shipped to production

Change Management Specialist Finance Transformation

Remote, United States

*This is a 6 month contract assignment

At Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE), we are transforming how Finance operates through innovation, technology modernization, and operational excellence. As part of the newly established Finance Transformation Office (FTO), the Change Management Specialist serves as the Organizational Change Management (OCM) lead responsible for designing and driving the people strategy that enables successful transformation across our global Finance organization.

Reporting to the Director of Finance Transformation, this individual contributor will develop enterprise-wide change management strategies, frameworks, governance, stakeholder engagement plans, communications, and adoption measurement that support successful implementation of Finance transformation initiatives. Working across Finance, IT, HR, and other business functions, this role will influence leaders at every level to build organizational readiness, accelerate adoption, and embed sustainable change.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise leading organizational change for complex Finance, ERP, or enterprise transformation programs. They combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and are comfortable partnering with executive leadership while influencing cross-functional stakeholders in a highly matrixed global environment.

Responsibilities:

Organizational Change Strategy & Planning

• Design, implement, and continuously evolve the Organizational Change Management (OCM) strategy supporting the Finance Transformation portfolio.
• Develop and maintain enterprise OCM frameworks, methodologies, governance models, and reusable toolkits that establish consistent change practices across initiatives.
• Lead Change Impact Assessments to identify impacted stakeholder groups, business risks, organizational dependencies, and adoption requirements.
• Establish governance for organizational readiness, change saturation, and adoption planning, providing insights and recommendations to transformation leadership.
• Develop stakeholder engagement strategies tailored to global, regional, and functional audiences.

Executive Sponsorship & Stakeholder Engagement

• Partner with executive sponsors across the C-suite, Finance Leadership Team (FLT), and Executive Leadership Team (ELT) to build active and visible sponsorship throughout the transformation lifecycle.
• Coach senior leaders on effective change leadership and provide strategic guidance, messaging, and materials that reinforce adoption.
• Develop Sponsor Coalition Maps that align executive sponsorship across workstreams and organizational levels.
• Build trusted relationships across Finance, HR, IT, and business leaders to drive alignment, engagement, and accountability.

Communications & Change Delivery

• Develop and execute integrated communication strategies that support Finance Transformation initiatives across global audiences.
• Create executive communications, leadership briefings, town halls, intranet content, and other change materials that reinforce transformation objectives.
• Design audience-specific communication plans based on stakeholder needs, organizational impact, geography, and business priorities.
• Establish enterprise OCM standards, templates, and toolkits that enable consistent change delivery across the Finance Transformation portfolio.
• Develop People Manager Enablement and Change Champion programs that equip leaders to effectively guide their teams through change.
• Implement feedback mechanisms to measure stakeholder sentiment and continuously improve communication effectiveness.

Change Readiness, Adoption & Reporting

• Define and implement enterprise change readiness assessments across Finance Transformation initiatives.
• Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide visibility into organizational readiness, adoption progress, key risks, and benefits realization.
• Establish and monitor key Organizational Change Management metrics, including stakeholder engagement, adoption, training effectiveness, communications impact, and sponsor effectiveness.
• Track adoption outcomes and provide data-driven recommendations that improve business performance and transformation success.
• Conduct post-implementation reviews and incorporate lessons learned into future change management practices.

Resistance Management

• Identify potential sources of organizational resistance and develop targeted strategies that improve stakeholder engagement and adoption.
• Apply established change management methodologies, including Prosci ADKAR or comparable frameworks, to support successful organizational transitions.
• Partner with business leaders to resolve adoption challenges and reinforce sustainable behavioral change across impacted teams.

Training & Capability Development

• Serve as the Organizational Change Management subject matter expert for the Finance Transformation Office, providing guidance and coaching across transformation initiatives.
• Conduct Training Needs Analyses and partner with HR and Learning & Development to develop learning pathways that prepare employees for new processes, systems, and ways of working.
• Design manager enablement resources that strengthen leadership capability and support successful change adoption.
• Measure training effectiveness and recommend improvements that accelerate user proficiency and long-term adoption.

Enterprise Change Capability

• Build long-term organizational change capability by developing reusable playbooks, governance models, knowledge repositories, and best practices that can be leveraged across future transformation initiatives.
• Promote continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance change management practices, tools, and organizational maturity.
• Design recognition strategies that reinforce desired behaviors, celebrate transformation milestones, and support sustained adoption.

• 8+ years of progressive Organizational Change Management experience supporting large-scale business transformation initiatives within complex global organizations.
• Demonstrated success developing enterprise-wide change management strategies for Finance, ERP, operating model, or technology transformation programs.
• Experience establishing Organizational Change Management governance, stakeholder engagement strategies, executive sponsorship programs, communications, training, and adoption frameworks.

· Responsible for continuous delivery of value to the customer through compelling and empowering customer experiences, accountable for a complex/ critical product, or multiple related products within a product family / portfolio.

Education and Experience

· Decision Making – Ability to know when and what decisions should be made and to make several decisions simultaneously in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.

ABOUT VOODOO

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Istanbul-based.

TEAM

You will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising Puzzle game in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

ROLE

As a Level Designer for one of our Puzzle Studio, you will be at the heart of the game's evolution. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, artists, and product experts to design, test, and refine features that keep our players engaged and entertained.

- Participate in the design and creation of engaging, challenging, and fun levels that maintain player interest and progression

- Develop and iterate on game mechanics and features that enhance the core gameplay loop

- Analyze player behavior, game metrics, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement

- Collaborate with engineers and artists to bring level designs and features to life

- Structure, run, and monitor A/B tests to validate design decisions and optimize player experience

- Balance game difficulty curves to ensure appropriate challenge and retention across all levels

- Stay up-to-date with the hybrid-casual and puzzle game market, analyzing competitor games and emerging trends

- Test and playtest levels and features to ensure quality and enjoyment

- Contribute to the product roadmap and strategic direction

- Work iteratively, rapidly prototyping ideas and incorporating feedback from the team and data

PROFILE

- 2+ years of professional experience in game design, product specialist, Level Design or similar role in the mobile gaming industry

- Strong passion for mobile puzzle and hybrid-casual games, with a deep understanding of what makes them engaging and successful

- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven design decisions

- Understanding of player psychology and what drives engagement, retention, and satisfaction in puzzle games

- Strong communication skills and ability to clearly articulate design ideas to cross-functional teams

- Iterative mindset with the ability to rapidly test, learn, and improve designs based on feedback

- Fluent in English

- Bonus: Experience with Unity or game development tools, knowledge of A/B testing methodologies, experience shipping successful mobile games

BENEFITS:

- Best in Class compensation

- Other benefits according to the country you reside.

jobs.description: SCOT's RoW Regional team is seeking an experienced and motivated Data Scientist to help optimize, enhance, and scale Supply Chain decision algorithms in countries beyond US/EU.
